title: Auxiliary Power Unit Mount Heat Shield — Installation
abstract: Installation of the auxiliary power unit mount heat shield, with the standoff sequence, the clearance check to the exhaust duct cold and hot, and the ground run that confirms the installation.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the mount heat shield and to confirm the clearance to the exhaust duct at ambient and after a ground run.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm which shield standard is to be fitted; the stiffened shield needs the two standoffs and a different fastener spacing at the forward edge, and the delivered shield must not be fitted to an aircraft with the shouldered forward link. Get the clearance gauge set and plan the twenty minute ground run into the task, because the hot clearance check cannot be skipped.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure the auxiliary power unit is isolated and the start control is tagged. 2. Examine the shield for cracking at the fastener holes and at the stiffening rib where fitted. 3. On aircraft post MOD-168086, install the two standoffs in the mount frame and torque to the value in the table. 4. Lift the shield into position with two people and engage it on the standoffs where fitted. 5. Install the fasteners, working from the forward edge aft, hand tight. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT PULL THE SHIELD FLAT WITH THE FASTENERS. A SHIELD FORCED FLAT WILL BUCKLE AT THE FIRST GROUND RUN. 7. Torque the fasteners in the sequence shown in the figure. 8. Measure the clearance to the exhaust duct at the four positions and confirm the minimum in the table is met. 9. Remove the tools and the barriers, close the compartment access. 10. Run the auxiliary power unit for twenty minutes at no load. 11. WARNING: LET THE COMPARTMENT COOL FOR TWO HOURS BEFORE THE HOT CLEARANCE CHECK. 12. Re-open the access and measure the same four clearances. Confirm no permanent change greater than one millimetre.
sections.close_out: Close the compartment access and remove the safety barriers. Remove the tag from the start control. Record the installation, the shield part number, both sets of clearance measurements and the ground run duration in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; step 3 applies to aircraft post MOD-168086 only

safety_precautions: Let the compartment cool for two hours before the hot clearance check.
Keep the start control tagged until the installation is complete.

title: Auxiliary Power Unit Mount Heat Shield — Installation

issue.reason: Hot clearance measurements made returnable to the fleet record, the task taking over as the continuing source of shield distortion data from the withdrawn survey bulletin.

Record the installation, the shield part number, both sets of clearance measurements and the ground run duration in the aircraft technical log. Return the cold and hot clearance readings to the manufacturer against the reference in the figure. This task is now the continuing source of shield distortion data for the fleet: the one-time survey that used to collect it under a separate bulletin is withdrawn, and the hot reading taken here after a real ground run is a better measurement than the cold survey it replaces because it is taken with the shield at working temperature.
